Name: Eladah
Summary: Son of Tahath and father of Tahath in Ephraim's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:20: Son of Tahath and father of Tahath in Ephraim's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Eladah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
